name: Hermes
title: Christian in Rome
summary: Hermes was a Christian who lived in Rome and whom the apostle Paul greeted in his letter to the Romans. He is mentioned among several believers belonging to the church in Rome in the first century.

keyEvents.title: Greeting from Paul
keyEvents.description: Paul sent greetings to Hermes along with several other believers in Rome, showing that he was a recognized part of the Christian community there.
